descriptionChirho: The proper name Solomon (Σολομών), referring to the son of David and king of Israel renowned for wisdom, used across all grammatical cases (nominative, accusative, genitive). All translations consistently transliterate the same personal name: Arabic سُلَيْمَانَ/سُلَيْمَانُ, Korean 솔로몬, Swahili Solomoni/Solomṓn, Hindi सोलोमōन/सुलैमान, Spanish Solomṓn. The genitive forms ('of Solomon') and nominative/accusative forms represent grammatical inflection of a single referent, not distinct senses.
